# African Medical Records

Source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Nigeria-Health-data-OCR-pipeline/African-Medical-Records
Licence: CC-BY-4.0 (verified at download time)
Files present: 140/140

Nigerian handwritten clinical documents with exact ground truth.
An external PROXY for UNTH documents, never a substitute: different
hospital, writers, forms and phones. Results from this dataset must
always be reported as African Medical Records results, never as evidence
about UNTH.

Attribution is required by CC-BY-4.0 wherever results are published.
